---
title: "2026-05-11 SCEPTRE - Run Pipeline"
output: html_document
params:
  sceptre_object_path: NULL
  prefix: "merged"
  integration_strategy: "union"
  n_processors: 2
---

```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(here)
})

if (!requireNamespace("sceptre", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package 'sceptre' is required. Install with renv::install('katsevich-lab/sceptre').")
}

prefix <- params$prefix
integration_strategy <- params$integration_strategy
n_processors <- as.integer(params$n_processors)

cat("Parameters for this run:\n")
cat("  sceptre_object_path:", params$sceptre_object_path, "\n")
cat("  prefix:", prefix, "\n")
cat("  integration_strategy:", integration_strategy, "\n")
cat("  n_processors:", n_processors, "\n")
```

```{r load-object}
output_root <- here("results", "2026-06-10_SCEPTRE")
tables_dir <- file.path(output_root, "tables")
runs_dir <- file.path(output_root, "runs")
merged_run_dir <- file.path(runs_dir, paste0(prefix, "_", integration_strategy))

dir.create(merged_run_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

if (is.null(params$sceptre_object_path) || !nzchar(params$sceptre_object_path)) {
  stop("sceptre_object_path param must be provided.")
}
if (!file.exists(here(params$sceptre_object_path))) {
  stop("SCEPTRE object not found: ", here(params$sceptre_object_path))
}

cat("\nLoading SCEPTRE object from:", here(params$sceptre_object_path), "\n")
sceptre_object_merged <- readRDS(here(params$sceptre_object_path))
cat("Loaded successfully\n")
print(sceptre_object_merged)
```

```{r set-analysis-params}
cat("\nSetting analysis parameters with integration strategy:", integration_strategy, "\n")

sceptre_object_merged <- sceptre::set_analysis_parameters(
  sceptre_object = sceptre_object_merged,
  discovery_pairs = sceptre_object_merged@discovery_pairs[, c("grna_target", "response_id")],
  side = "both",
  formula_object = sceptre_object_merged@formula_object,
  grna_integration_strategy = integration_strategy
)

print(sceptre_object_merged)
```

## Assign gRNAs

```{r assign-grnas}
cat("Assigning gRNAs using SCEPTRE defaults\n")

sceptre_object_merged <- sceptre::assign_grnas(
  sceptre_object = sceptre_object_merged,
  parallel = TRUE,
  n_processors = n_processors
)

print(sceptre_object_merged)
sceptre::plot_grna_count_distributions(sceptre_object_merged)
```

## Quality Control

```{r run-qc}
cat("Running QC with n_nonzero_trt_thresh=15 and n_nonzero_cntrl_thresh=15\n")

sceptre_object_merged <- sceptre::run_qc(
  sceptre_object = sceptre_object_merged,
  n_nonzero_trt_thresh = 15L,
  n_nonzero_cntrl_thresh = 15L
)

print(sceptre_object_merged)
```

## Calibration Check

```{r run-calibration}
cat("Running calibration check with", n_processors, "processors\n")

sceptre_object_merged <- sceptre::run_calibration_check(
  sceptre_object = sceptre_object_merged,
  parallel = TRUE,
  n_processors = n_processors
)

print(sceptre_object_merged)
calibration_result <- sceptre::get_result(
  sceptre_object = sceptre_object_merged,
  analysis = "run_calibration_check"
)
cat("Calibration results rows:", nrow(calibration_result), "\n")
print(head(calibration_result))
```

## Power Check

```{r run-power}
# Check if positive control pairs are available
has_pos_ctrl <- !is.null(sceptre_object_merged@positive_control_pairs) && nrow(sceptre_object_merged@positive_control_pairs) > 0

if (has_pos_ctrl) {
  cat("Running power check with", n_processors, "processors\n")
  
  sceptre_object_merged <- sceptre::run_power_check(
    sceptre_object = sceptre_object_merged,
    parallel = TRUE,
    n_processors = n_processors
  )
  
  print(sceptre_object_merged)
  power_result <- sceptre::get_result(
    sceptre_object = sceptre_object_merged,
    analysis = "run_power_check"
  )
  cat("Power results rows:", nrow(power_result), "\n")
  print(head(power_result))
} else {
  cat("Note: Positive control pairs not supplied. Skipping power check.\n")
  cat("To enable power check, supply positive_control_pairs in set_analysis_parameters().\n")
  power_result <- NULL
}
```

## Discovery Analysis

```{r run-discovery}
cat("Running discovery analysis with", n_processors, "processors\n")

sceptre_object_merged <- sceptre::run_discovery_analysis(
  sceptre_object = sceptre_object_merged,
  parallel = TRUE,
  n_processors = n_processors
)

print(sceptre_object_merged)
discovery_result <- sceptre::get_result(
  sceptre_object = sceptre_object_merged,
  analysis = "run_discovery_analysis"
)
cat("Discovery results rows:", nrow(discovery_result), "\n")
print(head(discovery_result))
```

## Write Outputs

```{r write-outputs}
cat("Writing outputs to:", merged_run_dir, "\n")

sceptre::write_outputs_to_directory(
  sceptre_object = sceptre_object_merged,
  directory = file.path(merged_run_dir, "sceptre_outputs")
)

# Export discovery and calibration results to TSV
data.table::fwrite(
  as.data.table(discovery_result),
  file.path(merged_run_dir, "sceptre_discovery_results.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

data.table::fwrite(
  as.data.table(calibration_result),
  file.path(merged_run_dir, "sceptre_calibration_results.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

if (!is.null(power_result)) {
  data.table::fwrite(
    as.data.table(power_result),
    file.path(merged_run_dir, "sceptre_power_check_results.tsv"),
    sep = "\t"
  )
}

# Save post-pipeline object
saveRDS(sceptre_object_merged, file.path(merged_run_dir, "sceptre_object_post_pipeline.rds"))

cat("Files saved to:", merged_run_dir, "\n")
list.files(merged_run_dir, recursive = TRUE)
```

## Summary

```{r summary}
summary_dt <- data.table(
  analysis_type = "merged_replicates",
  prefix = prefix,
  integration_strategy = integration_strategy,
  n_cells = ncol(sceptre_object_merged@response_matrix[[1]]),
  n_discovery_rows = nrow(discovery_result),
  n_significant = sum(discovery_result$significant %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_power_rows = if (!is.null(power_result)) nrow(power_result) else NA_integer_,
  n_calibration_rows = nrow(calibration_result),
  n_processors = n_processors,
  merged_run_dir = file.path("results", "2026-06-10_SCEPTRE", "runs", basename(merged_run_dir))
)

data.table::fwrite(summary_dt, file.path(tables_dir, paste0("sceptre_pipeline_", prefix, "_", integration_strategy, ".tsv")), sep = "\t")

cat("\n=== MERGED REPLICATES ANALYSIS SUMMARY ===\n")
print(summary_dt)
```

## Output Files

```{r output-files}
cat("Run directories:\n")
print(list.files(runs_dir, full.names = FALSE))
cat("Tables directory files:\n")
print(list.files(tables_dir, full.names = FALSE))
```
